reason: A browser-side writing workspace that provides sidebar panels and a session index for novel projects, libraries, full-text search, evolution diffs, thread visualization, and host-side orchestration triggers.

summaries.zh: 为长篇小说创作提供浏览器侧写作面板和全书索引，支持项目与书库浏览、全文搜索、演化 diff、线索图谱及章节编排触发。
summaries.en: A browser-side writing workspace for long-form novels with project and library views, full-text search, evolution diffs, thread graphs, chapter navigation, and host-side orchestration triggers.

capabilities: Displays project, library, search, evolution, and full-book index views
Reads writing-project and library data through a host-side remote service
Triggers host-side writing orchestration actions such as novel_sync
Provides SVG thread-graph visualization and chapter navigation
